title: livecd-use-git → ubuntu/master
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index c6f72ee..373c182 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,21 @@
+livecd-rootfs (26.10.20) tenacious; urgency=medium
+
+  [ livecd-rootfs git-seeds work ]
+  * Fetch seeds directly from the git seed repositories on
+    git.launchpad.net via germinate --vcs=git instead of via the
+    ubuntu-archive-team.ubuntu.com / static-reports.ubuntu.com seed
+    mirrors (LP: #2167508). The mirrors are only cron-updated git
+    checkouts of the same repositories (canonical/
+    ubuntu-static-reports-operator, update-seeds), so this removes a
+    moving piece of infrastructure between the seeds and the image
+    builds that can break.
+  * SEEDMIRROR is dropped in favour of SEEDGIT, a comma-separated list
+    of git base URLs (default: the ubuntu-core-dev repositories for the
+    platform seeds included by every flavour, plus the flavour's owning
+    team).
+
+ -- Christian Ehrhardt <christian.ehrhardt@canonical.com>  Thu, 12 Nov 2026 15:02:42 +0100
+
 livecd-rootfs (26.10.19) stonking; urgency=medium
 
   [ Valentin Haudiquet ]

index a406be5..153ad2d 100755

+++ b/live-build/auto/build

@@ -32,18 +32,16 @@ fi

-if [ -z "$MIRROR" ] || [ -z "$SEEDMIRROR" ]; then
+if [ -z "$MIRROR" ]; then

 			: ${MIRROR:=http://ftpmaster.internal/ubuntu/}
-			: ${SEEDMIRROR:=http://archive-team.internal/seeds/}

 				i386|amd64|arm64)	: ${MIRROR:=http://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/} ;;
 				*)			: ${MIRROR:=http://ports.ubuntu.com/ubuntu-ports/} ;;
 			esac
-			: ${SEEDMIRROR:=https://ubuntu-archive-team.ubuntu.com/seeds/}
 			;;
 	esac
 fi
@@ -595,42 +593,60 @@ if [ "${SUBPROJECT:-}" = minimized ]; then
 fi
 
 mkdir -p config/germinate-output
+# SEED_TEAM is the Launchpad team owning this flavour's seed repository;
+# see https://git.launchpad.net/~<team>/ubuntu-seeds/+git/<flavour>
 case $PROJECT in
         edubuntu*)
                 FLAVOUR=edubuntu
+                SEED_TEAM=edubuntu-dev
                 ;;
         kubuntu*)
                 FLAVOUR=kubuntu
+                SEED_TEAM=kubuntu-dev
                 ;;
         xubuntu*)
                 FLAVOUR=xubuntu
+                SEED_TEAM=xubuntu-dev
                 ;;
         ubuntu-mate*)
                 FLAVOUR=ubuntu-mate
+                SEED_TEAM=ubuntu-mate-dev
                 ;;
         ubuntu-unity*)
                 FLAVOUR=ubuntu-unity
+                SEED_TEAM=unity7maintainers
                 ;;
         lubuntu*)
                 FLAVOUR=lubuntu
+                SEED_TEAM=lubuntu-dev
                 ;;
         ubuntu-budgie*)
                 FLAVOUR=ubuntu-budgie
+                SEED_TEAM=ubuntubudgie-dev
                 ;;
         ubuntukylin*)
                 FLAVOUR=ubuntukylin
+                SEED_TEAM=ubuntukylin-members
                 ;;
         ubuntustudio*)
                 FLAVOUR=ubuntustudio
+                SEED_TEAM=ubuntustudio-dev
                 ;;
         ubuntucinnamon*)
                 FLAVOUR=ubuntucinnamon
+                SEED_TEAM=ubuntucinnamon-dev
                 ;;
         *)
                 FLAVOUR=ubuntu
+                SEED_TEAM=ubuntu-core-dev
                 ;;
 esac
 
+# Seeds are fetched directly from the owning team's git repository (plus
+# ubuntu-core-dev for the shared platform repository included by every
+# flavour's STRUCTURE) instead of via a seed mirror.
+: ${SEEDGIT:=https://git.launchpad.net/~ubuntu-core-dev/ubuntu-seeds/+git/,https://git.launchpad.net/~${SEED_TEAM}/ubuntu-seeds/+git/}
+
 case $PROJECT in
 	ubuntu-mini-iso|ubuntu-test-iso)
 		COMPONENTS='main'
@@ -667,7 +683,7 @@ case $PROJECT in
 				GERMINATE_PPA_ARGS="$GERMINATE_PPA_ARGS -m https://ppa.launchpadcontent.net/$ppa/ubuntu"
 			done
 			(cd config/germinate-output && germinate --no-rdepends --no-installer \
-				-S $SEEDMIRROR -m $MIRROR $GERMINATE_PPA_ARGS -d $SUITE,$SUITE-updates \
+				--vcs=git -S $SEEDGIT -m $MIRROR $GERMINATE_PPA_ARGS -d $SUITE,$SUITE-updates \
 				-s $FLAVOUR.$SUITE $GERMINATE_ARG -a ${ARCH_VARIANT:-$ARCH})
 		fi
 		;;
@@ -1337,28 +1353,6 @@ if [ "$PROJECT:${SUBPROJECT:-}" = ubuntu-cpc:minimized ]; then
 	truncate --size 0 config/seeded-snaps
 fi

-		;;

-	if [ -n "${minimal_packages_remove}" ]; then

 export APT_OPTIONS
